analysis_policy.resume_contract: checkpoint, dataset, panel, model configuration, memory mode, limits, and deterministic work-plan hashes must match

expected_impact: The bounded pilot provides an early balanced health check but cannot replace the uncapped held-out baseline or support model selection. Interrupted evaluation can restart from its last durable segment checkpoint without double-counting evidence.
rationale: The original 03j evaluation traversed 41,615,672 held-out predictable bases with adaptive inner-loop memory updates, emitted no progress, and had no resume artifact. Colab interruptions could therefore discard many hours of work. A bounded accession-balanced T4 pilot and a resumable A100 full evaluation separate operational validation from the predeclared full baseline while preserving the frozen protocol.
